articles.title_en: JUE Insight: Firms and industry agglomeration
articles.abstract_en: Industry agglomeration can be indicative of agglomeration forces and is correlated with firm outcomes. Because multi-plant firms tend cluster their establishments in space, industry agglomeration could in part be driven by forces internal to the firm rather than across-firm spillovers. We propose and implement a decomposition of the industry agglomeration measures into within and across-firm components using U.S. census microdata. The within-firm component makes a small contribution to observed industry agglomeration for most industries and spatial scales, but accounts for 20% or more of observed agglomeration at short spatial scales for a subset of industries.
articles.abstract_cn: 产业集聚可能表明集聚力量的存在，并与企业绩效相关。由于多工厂企业倾向于在空间上集中其机构，产业集聚可能部分由企业内部力量而非跨企业溢出效应驱动。我们提出并利用美国人口普查微观数据，将产业集聚度量分解为企业内和企业间组成部分。对于大多数产业和空间尺度，企业内组成部分对观察到的产业集聚贡献较小，但在短空间尺度上，对于一部分产业，其占观察到的集聚的20%或更多。

articles.title_en: JUE Insight: The effect of new market-rate housing construction on the low-income housing market
articles.title_cn: JUE洞察：新建市场价住房建设对低收入住房市场的影响
articles.abstract_en: I illustrate how new market-rate construction loosens the market for lower-quality housing through a series of moves. First, I use address history data to identify 52,000 residents of new multifamily buildings in large cities, their previous address, the current residents of those addresses, and so on for six rounds. The sequence quickly reaches units in below-median income neighborhoods, which account for nearly 40 percent of the sixth round, and similar patterns appear for neighborhoods in the bottom quintile of income or percent white. Next, I use a simple simulation model to roughly quantify these migratory connections under a range of assumptions. Constructing a new market-rate building that houses 100 people ultimately leads 45 to 70 people to move out of below-median income neighborhoods, with most of the effect occurring within three years. These results suggest that the migration ripple effects of new housing will affect a wide spectrum of neighborhoods and loosen the low-income housing market.
articles.abstract_cn: 我通过一系列迁移过程说明新建市场价住房如何松动低质量住房市场。首先，我使用地址历史数据识别大城市新建多户住宅楼中的52,000名居民、他们之前的地址、这些地址的当前居民，并如此进行六轮追踪。这一序列很快到达收入低于中位数的社区，这些社区在第六轮中占近40%，在收入或白人比例最低五分位的社区中也出现类似模式。接下来，我使用一个简单的模拟模型，在一系列假设下粗略量化这些迁移联系。建造一栋容纳100人的新建市场价建筑，最终导致45至70人搬离收入低于中位数的社区，且大部分效应在三年内显现。这些结果表明，新住房的迁移涟漪效应将影响广泛的社区，并松动低收入住房市场。

articles.title_en: JUE Insight: Zoning and property taxation revisited—Was Hamilton right?
articles.title_cn: JUE洞察：分区与财产税再探讨——汉密尔顿是对的吗？
articles.abstract_en: In rare theoretical treatments of ideas developed by Hamilton (1975, 1976) almost fifty wears ago, recent papers by Barseghyan and Coate (2016) and Calabrese et al. (2007) develop dynamic models to analyze zoning and property taxation in a system of communities. Their analyses led to negative conclusions, contradicting Hamilton’s view, by showing that efficient zoning does not emerge in equilibrium. The purpose of this note is to show that a different, affirmative conclusion can be reached in a simpler, highly stylized model that formalizes Hamilton’s idea.
articles.abstract_cn: 在近五十年前汉密尔顿（1975，1976）提出的思想的罕见理论处理中，Barseghyan和Coate（2016）以及Calabrese等人（2007）的最新论文开发了动态模型来分析社区体系中的分区和财产税。他们的分析得出了负面结论，与汉密尔顿的观点相矛盾，表明有效分区不会在均衡中出现。本文的目的是表明，在一个更简单、高度风格化的模型中，可以得出不同的、肯定的结论，该模型形式化了汉密尔顿的思想。

articles.title_en: JUE Insight: The Impacts of Opportunity Zones on Zone Residents
articles.title_cn: JUE洞察：机会区对区内居民的影响
articles.abstract_en: The Opportunity Zone program, created by the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act in 2017, was designed to encourage investment in distressed communities across the U.S. We examine the early impacts (up to one-and-a-half years after enactment) of the Opportunity Zone program on residents of targeted areas. We leverage restricted-access microdata from the American Community Survey and employ a matching approach to estimate causal effects of Opportunity Zone designation. Our results point to little or no evidence of positive effects of the Opportunity Zone program on the employment, earnings, or poverty of zone residents.
articles.abstract_cn: 机会区项目由2017年《减税与就业法案》设立，旨在鼓励对美国各地困境社区的投资。我们考察了机会区项目对目标地区居民的早期影响（颁布后至多一年半）。我们利用美国社区调查的限制访问微观数据，并采用匹配方法来估计机会区指定的因果效应。我们的结果表明，几乎没有证据表明机会区项目对区内居民的就业、收入或贫困产生积极影响。

articles.title_en: JUE Insight: The (non-)effect of opportunity zones on housing prices
articles.title_cn: JUE洞察：机会区对房价的（非）影响
articles.abstract_en: Will the Opportunity Zones (OZ) program, America’s largest new place-based policy in decades, generate neighborhood change? We compare single-family housing price growth in OZs with price growth in areas that were eligible but not included in the program. We also compare OZs to their nearest geographic neighbors. Our most credible estimates rule out price impacts greater than 0.5 percentage points with 95% confidence, suggesting that, so far, home buyers don’t believe that this subsidy will generate major neighborhood change. OZ status reduces prices in areas with little employment, perhaps because buyers think that subsidizing new investment will increase housing supply. Mixed evidence suggests that OZs may have increased residential permitting.
articles.abstract_cn: 机会区（OZ）计划是美国几十年来最大的新地方性政策，它是否会产生社区变化？我们将机会区的单户住宅价格增长与符合条件但未被纳入该计划的地区的价格增长进行比较。我们还将机会区与其最近的地理邻居进行比较。我们最可信的估计排除了价格影响大于0.5个百分点（95%置信度）的可能性，这表明到目前为止，购房者并不认为这项补贴会产生重大的社区变化。在就业较少的地区，机会区地位降低了房价，可能是因为购房者认为补贴新投资将增加住房供应。混合证据表明，机会区可能增加了住宅许可。

articles.title_en: JUE Insight: Measuring the Stringency of Land Use Regulation Using a Shadow Price Approach
articles.title_cn: JUE洞察：使用影子价格方法衡量土地使用监管的严格程度
articles.abstract_en: I propose a shadow price approach to measuring the stringency of land use regulation. A regulation is considered more restrictive if the land developer is willing to pay a larger amount for a marginal relaxation of the regulation. I show that existing theory-based measures of land use stringency are either equivalents or variations of this shadow price measure. Using data from China, I demonstrate that it is possible to compare the stringency of two kinds of land use regulation, a key advantage of this shadow price approach.
articles.abstract_cn: 我提出了一种影子价格方法来衡量土地使用监管的严格程度。如果土地开发商愿意为监管的边际放松支付更大的金额，则认为该监管更具限制性。我表明，现有的基于理论的土地使用严格程度衡量指标要么是这种影子价格衡量指标的等价物，要么是其变体。利用中国数据，我证明了比较两种土地使用监管的严格程度是可能的，这是这种影子价格方法的一个关键优势。

articles.title_en: JUE Insight: Is hospital quality predictive of pandemic deaths? Evidence from US counties
articles.title_cn: JUE洞察：医院质量能否预测疫情死亡？来自美国县级数据的证据
articles.abstract_en: In the large literature on the spatial-level correlates of COVID-19, the association between quality of hospital care and outcomes has received little attention to date. To examine whether county-level mortality is correlated with measures of hospital performance, we assess daily cumulative deaths and pre-crisis measures of hospital quality, accounting for state fixed-effects and potential confounders. As a measure of quality, we use the pre-pandemic adjusted five-year penalty rates for excess 30-day readmissions following pneumonia admissions for the hospitals accessible to county residents based on ambulance travel patterns. Our adjustment corrects for socio-economic status and down-weighs observations based on small samples. We find that a one-standard-deviation increase in the quality of local hospitals is associated with a 2% lower death rate (relative to the mean of 20 deaths per 10,000 people) one and a half years after the first recorded death.
articles.abstract_cn: 在关于COVID-19空间层面相关因素的大量文献中，医院护理质量与结果之间的关联至今鲜少受到关注。为检验县级死亡率是否与医院绩效指标相关，我们评估了每日累计死亡数和危机前的医院质量指标，并控制了州固定效应和潜在混杂因素。作为质量衡量指标，我们使用了疫情前调整后的肺炎入院后30天内超额再入院五年惩罚率，该指标基于救护车出行模式，针对县级居民可及的医院。我们的调整修正了社会经济状况，并对小样本观测进行了降权。我们发现，当地医院质量每提高一个标准差，在首次记录死亡后一年半时，死亡率（相对于每10,000人中20例死亡的平均值）降低2%。

articles.title_en: JUE Insight: Powering work from home
articles.title_cn: JUE洞察：为在家工作提供动力
articles.abstract_en: This paper documents a shift in energy consumption toward residential usage during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States. Focusing on electricity, I find a 7.9% increase in residential consumption, and a 6.9% and 8.0% reduction in commercial and industrial usage, respectively, from a monthly panel of electric utilities. Natural gas consumption also shifted toward residential use, so that aggregate electricity and gas expenditure only fell by 1% on net during a period in which GDP fell by 5%. Hourly smart meter data from Texas reveal how daily routines changed during the pandemic, with residential electricity usage during weekdays closely resembling those of weekends. In total, residential energy expenditures were an estimated $13B higher during Q2-Q4 2020, with the largest increases occurring in areas with a greater propensity to work from home. I find that transportation fuel consumption declined about 16%, so that total energy consumption in the U.S. economy fell by 8%.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文记录了美国新冠肺炎19大流行期间能源消耗向住宅使用的转变。就电力而言，我发现住宅消费增加了7.9%，商业和工业用电量分别减少了6.9%和8.0%，从每月的电力公用事业面板来看。天然气消费也转向住宅使用，因此在 GDP 下降 5% 期间，电力和天然气总支出仅净下降 1%。德克萨斯州每小时的智能电表数据揭示了大流行期间日常生活的变化，工作日的住宅用电量与周末的用电量非常相似。总体而言，Q2-Q4 2020期间，住宅能源支出估计增加了 $13B，其中增幅最大的地区是更倾向于在家工作的地区。我发现交通燃料消耗下降了约16%，使得美国经济的能源消耗总量下降了8%。

articles.title_en: JUE Insight: Urban flight seeded the COVID-19 pandemic across the United States
articles.title_cn: JUE洞察：城市外逃在美国播下了COVID-19大流行的种子
articles.abstract_en: We document large-scale urban flight in the United States during the COVID-19 pandemic. Regions that saw migrant influx experienced greater subsequent new COVID-19 cases, linking urban flight (as a disease vector) and coronavirus spread in destination areas. Urban residents fled to socially connected areas, consistent with the theory that individuals sheltered with friends and family, or in second homes. Populations that fled were disproportionately younger, whiter, and wealthier. The association between migration and subsequent new cases persists when instrumenting for migration with social networks.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了美国在COVID-19大流行期间的大规模城市外逃。出现移民流入的地区随后新增COVID-19病例更多，这将对城市外逃（作为疾病传播载体）与目的地地区冠状病毒传播联系起来。城市居民逃往社交联系紧密的地区，这与个体在亲友处或第二居所避难的假说一致。外逃人口不成比例地更年轻、更白、更富有。当使用社交网络作为移民的工具变量时，移民与随后新增病例之间的关联仍然存在。

articles.title_en: JUE Insight: Using the mode to test for selection in city size wage premia
articles.title_cn: JUE洞察：利用众数检验城市规模工资溢价中的选择性
articles.abstract_en: The causal effect of city size on urban wage premia has been difficult to measure because unusually skilled workers may select into large city labor markets. We propose a new approach to this challenge. For single-peaked wage distributions, if individuals left of the mode disproportionately select out of large city labor markets, the CDF evaluated at the mode shrinks as city size increases. Among college trained, white full-time US workers, evidence of selection is present even after conditioning on extensive observable attributes. Among individuals with a high school degree or less, selection is absent. Additional estimates indicate that for college trained workers, 3.5% is an upper bound on the modal worker's wage elasticity with respect to city size. For those with limited education we can be more precise: modal wage elasticity is 3.9% for men and 5.2% for married women.
articles.abstract_cn: 城市规模对城市工资溢价的因果效应一直难以衡量，因为异常熟练的工人可能会选择进入大城市劳动力市场。我们针对这一挑战提出了一种新方法。对于单峰工资分布，如果众数左侧的个体不成比例地选择退出大城市劳动力市场，则随着城市规模的增加，在众数处评估的累积分布函数会缩小。在美国受过大学教育的全职白人工人中，即使在控制了广泛的可观测属性之后，选择性的证据仍然存在。在高中或以下学历的个体中，不存在选择性。额外的估计表明，对于受过大学教育的工人，3.5%是众数工人工资弹性相对于城市规模的上限。对于受教育程度有限的人，我们可以更精确：男性众数工资弹性为3.9%，已婚女性为5.2%。

articles.title_en: JUE Insight: Difference-in-differences with geocoded microdata
articles.title_cn: JUE洞察：地理编码微观数据中的双重差分法
articles.abstract_en: I formalize a commonly-used estimator for the effects of spatially-targeted treatment with geocoded microdata. This estimator compares units immediately next to treatment to units slightly further away. I introduce intuitive identifying assumptions for the average treatment effect among affected units and illustrate problems when these assumptions fail. I propose a new method that allows for nonparametric estimation following methods introduced in Cattaneo et al.(2019b) that allows estimation without requiring knowledge of exactly how far treatment effects are experienced. Since treatment effects can change with distance, the proposed estimator improves estimation by estimating a treatment effect curve.
articles.abstract_cn: 我形式化了一个常用于地理编码微观数据中空间定向处理效应的估计量。该估计量将紧邻处理区域的单位与稍远一些的单位进行比较。我引入了针对受影响单位平均处理效应的直观识别假设，并说明了当这些假设不成立时存在的问题。我提出了一种新方法，允许采用Cattaneo等人(2019b)引入的方法进行非参数估计，该方法无需确切知道处理效应影响的距离即可进行估计。由于处理效应可能随距离变化，所提出的估计量通过估计处理效应曲线来改进估计。

articles.title_en: JUE Insight: Making it home? Evidence on the long-run impact of an intensive support program for the chronically homeless on housing, employment and health
articles.title_cn: JUE洞察：实现安居？关于针对长期无家可归者的强化支持项目对住房、就业和健康的长期影响的证据
articles.abstract_en: Interventions that combine unconditional permanent housing with support services, known as Housing First approaches, generally improve housing outcomes for people who have experienced chronic homelessness. However, little is known about their long-run outcomes or the consequences of ending such services. We investigate both aspects by examining the long-run effects of an intensive support program on the housing, employment, and health outcomes of chronically homeless people in Australia. Evaluating the three-year program over six-years using a randomised controlled trial, we document substantially higher rates of housing and better employment outcomes during the program period for the treated group, but no substantial changes in health. Three years after the program ends, we observe no significant differences between the treatment and control group with respect to any outcomes, including housing. Our results imply that stable housing is a necessary but not sufficient condition to overcome multiple sources of economic and social disadvantage.
articles.abstract_cn: 将无条件永久住房与支持服务相结合的干预措施，即“住房优先”方法，通常能改善长期无家可归者的住房结果。然而，关于其长期结果或终止此类服务的后果知之甚少。我们通过考察澳大利亚一项强化支持项目对长期无家可归者在住房、就业和健康结果方面的长期影响来研究这两个方面。使用随机对照试验对为期三年的项目进行六年评估，我们记录了在项目期间，治疗组在住房和就业结果方面显著更高的比率，但健康方面没有实质性变化。项目结束三年后，我们观察到治疗组和对照组在任何结果（包括住房）方面均无显著差异。我们的结果表明，稳定住房是克服多重经济和社会劣势的必要但非充分条件。

articles.title_en: JUE Insight: Condominium development does not lead to gentrification
articles.title_cn: JUE洞察：共管公寓开发不会导致绅士化
articles.abstract_en: Many politicians and voters believe that condominium development hastens gentrification. Indeed, there is a strong positive correlation between the presence of condos in a neighborhood and resident socioeconomic status. We leverage the introduction of municipal regulations to study the causal effect of condo conversions on neighborhood attributes. Cities that restricted condo conversions experience a persistent decline in the condo share of the housing stock, relative to their neighboring suburbs and compared to metropolitan areas without such restrictions, even at city/suburb borders. Yet, areas with a higher condo share due to local regulations do not have residents with higher income or education levels.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多政治家和选民认为共管公寓开发会加速绅士化。事实上，社区中共管公寓的存在与居民社会经济地位之间存在强烈的正相关关系。我们利用市政法规的引入来研究共管公寓转换对社区属性的因果效应。限制共管公寓转换的城市，其住房存量中共管公寓份额相对于邻近郊区以及没有此类限制的大都市地区持续下降，即使在城市/郊区边界也是如此。然而，由于地方法规而拥有较高共管公寓份额的地区，其居民的收入或教育水平并未更高。

articles.title_en: JUE Insight: City-wide effects of new housing supply: Evidence from moving chains
articles.title_cn: JUE洞察：新增住房供应的城市范围效应——来自搬迁链的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the city-wide effects of new, centrally-located market-rate housing supply using geo-coded population-wide register data from the Helsinki Metropolitan Area. The supply of new market rate units triggers moving chains that quickly reach middle- and low-income neighborhoods and individuals. Thus, new market-rate construction loosens the housing market in middle- and low-income areas even in the short run. Market-rate supply is likely to improve affordability outside the sub-markets where new construction occurs and to benefit low-income people.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用赫尔辛基大都会区的地理编码人口全覆盖登记数据，研究了位于市中心的新增市场价住房供应的城市范围效应。新增市场价单元供应触发的搬迁链迅速延伸至中低收入社区和个人。因此，即使在短期内，新增市场价建设也会松动中低收入地区的住房市场。市场价供应很可能改善新建区域以外子市场的可负担性，并使低收入人群受益。

articles.title_en: JUE Insight: COVID-19 and household preference for urban density in China
articles.title_cn: JUE洞察：COVID-19与中国城市密度偏好
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the effect of COVID-19 on both housing prices and housing price gradients in China using transaction level data from 60 Chinese cities. After using a difference-in-differences (DID) specification to disentangle the confounding effects of China's annual Spring Festival, we find that housing prices decreased by two percent immediately after the COVID-19 outbreak but gradually recovered by September 2020. Moreover, our findings suggest that COVID-19 flattens the horizontal housing price gradient, reduces the price premium for living in tall buildings, and changes the vertical gradient within residential buildings. This is likely explained by the changing household preferences towards low-density areas associated with lower infection risk.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用中国60个城市的交易层面数据，研究了COVID-19对房价和房价梯度的影响。通过使用双重差分（DID）规范来排除中国春节的混淆效应，我们发现房价在COVID-19爆发后立即下降了百分之二，但到2020年九月逐渐恢复。此外，我们的研究结果表明，COVID-19使水平房价梯度变得平缓，降低了居住在高层建筑中的价格溢价，并改变了住宅建筑内的垂直梯度。这可能归因于家庭偏好转向低密度区域，这些区域与较低的感染风险相关。
